attempts.raw: {"risk": 4, "reason": "Switching SQLite from Shared to Default cache mode changes cross-connection visibility/locking semantics for all SQLite-backed tenants (including in-memory databases relying on shared cache), which can break multi-tenant data consistency without obvious test coverage."}
